div.div: R. Q. 2 تَطَأْطَأَ It was, or became, low, or depressed. (S, O.) It (the head) was, or became, lowered. (K.) See also the first paragraph, in three places. One says also, تَطَاوَلَ عَلَىَّ فَتَطَأْطَأْتُ مِنْهُ [app. meaning (assumed tropical:) He domineered over me, or exalted himself above me, and I humbled, or abased, myself to him: see طأْطَأَ مِنْ فُلَانٍ, above]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
